entries.def:
συν-ζάω (Rec. συζ-), 
to live with: opposite to συναποθανεῖν, 2Co.7.3 of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, Rom.6.8, 2Ti.2.11.†
(AS)

συν-ζεύγνυμι
(Rec. συζ-), [in LXX: Ezk.1.11, 23 (חָבַר) * ;] 
to yoke to­gether: metaphorically, of union in wedlock, Mat.19.6, Mrk.10.9.†
(AS)

συν-ζητέω
(Rec. συζ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Neh.2.4 AB1 (בָּקַשׁ pi.) * ;] 
__1. to search or examine together (Plat.). 
__2. In NT (and π., see MM, xxiii; also in MGr., see Kennedy, Sources, 155), to discuss, dispute: Mrk.1.27; 12.28, Luk.24.15; before quæst. indir., Mrk.9.10 with dative of person(s), Mrk.8.11 Act.6.9; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Mrk.9.14, 16, Act.9.29; id. before quæst. indir., Luk.22.23.†…

συν-ζήτηαις (Rec. συζ-), -εως, ἡ 
disputation: Act.28.29 (WH, R, txt., om.).†
(AS)

συν-ζητητής (Rec. συζ-), -οῦ, ἁ 
(συνζητέω), 
a disputer, disputant: 1Co.1.20.†
(AS)

σύν-ζυγος (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον 
(συνζεύγνυμι), [in Aq., Ezk.23.21 * ;] 
a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, Php.4.3 (see ICC, Lft., in l; MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-, 
to make alive or quicken together with; metaphorically, of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, Eph.2.5 σὺν τ. Χ., Col.2.13.†
(AS)

συκάμινος, -ου, ἡ 
[in LXX for שִׁקְמָה (pl.) ;] 
the mulberry tree 
(Lat. morus; cf. μόρον, 1Ma.6.34 *), 
the sycamine: Luk.17.6. (In LXX, σ. appears to represent the συκόμορος (see: συκομορέα), but St. Luke distinguishes between the two; see ICC, in l; DB, iv, 634.) †
(AS)

συκῆ (contr. fr. συκέα), -ῆς, ἡ 
(σῦκον), [in LXX for תְּאֵן ;] 
a fig-tree: Mat.21.19-21; 24.32, Mrk.11.13, 20-21; 13.28, Luk.13.6-7; 21.29, Jhn.1.49, 51, Jas.3.12, Rev.6.13.†
(AS)

συκο-μορέα (Rec. -μωραία, L, -μωρέα), -ας, ἡ, more commonly (so Aq., Sm., Psa.78.47, Isa.9.10) συκόμορος 
(σῦκον + μόρον, the black mulberry), 
a fig-mulberry, a sycamore: Luk.19.4 (cf. συκάμινος).†
(AS)
